scripts.start: bun run build:mcp-bridge && bun run --cwd apps/desktop dev
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build:renderer && bun run --cwd apps/mcp-bridge build:binary
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/mcp-contract typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/mcp-bridge typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/desktop typecheck
scripts.build:app: bun run build:mcp-bridge && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build:app
scripts.release: bun run build:mcp-bridge && bun run --cwd apps/desktop release
scripts.clean: rm -rf build dist .mirin .cache apps/desktop/build apps/desktop/dist apps/desktop/.mirin node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
